This report presents the probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) for the project site.
This document is delivered in HTML format and includes all results, scenarios, and supporting visualizations (dynamic charts and interactive maps). It is the complete and official version of record, available both offline and online at [`r params$URL`](`r params$URL`). A companion DOCX/PDF document is provided for reference and contains only the principal summary tables for seismic design parameters.
:::
